description: This Go source file defines functions for verifying group names and JSON tag naming conventions within Kubernetes API schemes, including internal and external type handling.

methods.name: VerifyGroupNames
methods.description: Checks that all group names in the scheme end with '.k8s.io', allowing exceptions via a set of legacy unsuffixed groups.

methods.name: VerifyTagNaming
methods.description: Ensures that all types in the scheme have appropriate JSON tags, with distinctions between internal and external types, and validates tag naming conventions.

methods.name: ensureNoTags
methods.description: Recursively verifies that internal types do not have JSON or protobuf tags.

methods.name: ensureTags
methods.description: Recursively verifies that external types have proper JSON tags and naming conventions.

methods.name: fmtParentString
methods.description: Formats a string representation of the parent type hierarchy for debugging.

methods.name: containsType
methods.description: Checks if a slice of reflect.Type contains a specific reflect.Type.
